summary: Round 68 fixes — comprehensive backend + frontend testing. ALL 15 backend pytest tests PASS (including 3 NEW test_ai_round68.py). Frontend: Carburante future-day block WORKS (alert fires + modal does not open); right-chevron next-month DISABLED (aria-disabled=true) on current month; future days visibly dimmed (opacity 0.35); holiday/school legend rendered ('Festa nazionale' + 'Scuole chiuse (Lombardia)'); yellow markers on weekdays + red dot on June 2 (Festa Repubblica). Agenda calendar shows same legend ('Festa nazionale' + 'Scuole chiuse · Lombardia') with red dot on June 2 and yellow markers on school-closure weekdays. BuongiornoModal: initial AI greeting now mentions '🏛️ Posso aggiornarti su bandi attivi e normative di settore per Provincia di Milano/Lombardia' (Unione Commercianti requirement satisfied); 3 quick chips present (🏛️ Bandi & Normative, 📅 Feste & Scuole, 📊 Riepilogo mese); tapping 'Bandi & Normative' triggers full AI response citing confcommerciomilano.it, ASCO/Unione Commercianti Milano, INPS, Agenzia Entrate — institutional sources covered. ONE MINOR FRONTEND I18N BUG: future-day alert displays raw key 'gas.noFutureRefuel' instead of the Italian translation (root cause: t() returns the key when missing, so `t('gas.noFutureRefuel') || 'fallback'` never falls through). User sees 'gas.noFutureRefuel' instead of 'Non puoi registrare un rifornimento per un giorno futuro'.

ui_bugs.issue: Alert shows raw i18n key 'gas.noFutureRefuel' instead of the Italian message. Root cause: code uses `t('gas.noFutureRefuel') || 'Non puoi...'` but i18next returns the key string when missing, so the `||` fallback never triggers (the key is truthy). User sees the literal 'gas.noFutureRefuel' in the alert. Fix: either add the key to it.json translations OR change to `t('gas.noFutureRefuel', { defaultValue: 'Non puoi registrare un rifornimento per un giorno futuro.' })`. Affects gas.tsx lines 226 and 259 (both handleDayPress and handleSaveDayRifornimento). Same pattern likely exists for 'gas.invalidAmount' and 'gas.enterValidAmount'.

rca_of_issue:
Backend AI 'Unione Commercianti' missing-functions report (user issue #2): RCA — Round 67 system prompt mentioned bandi only optionally. Round 68 fix in server.py made the 🏛️ bandi/normative section MANDATORY when region is resolved. Verified via E2E: greeting now ALWAYS includes 'Posso aggiornarti su bandi attivi e normative di settore per Provincia di {city}/{region}' and the Bandi chip triggers a full response citing confcommerciomilano.it, ASCO/Unione Commercianti Milano, INPS, Agenzia Entrate.

Carburante 'conti non tornano' (user issue #1): RCA — users could tap future days in the calendar grid and register fuel for tomorrow/next week, then those values polluted the monthly KPI totals. Round 68 fix: tap-handler hard-blocks any day > today (with alert), save-handler has a second guard, future days are visually dimmed (opacity 0.35), and the month navigator's '>' chevron is disabled at current month so users cannot even visit future months. Verified all four protections at runtime.

Calendar 'feste e chiusure scolastiche' (user issue #3): RCA — calendar previously had no visual feedback for holidays/school closures. Round 68 added /app/frontend/src/utils/italianCalendar.ts with dynamic Easter calculation, 12 national holidays, regional school closures (Lombardia/Veneto/Sicily/etc.), and a getDayMarker function that gas.tsx + agenda.tsx consume to render red/yellow dots + a legend below each calendar.
